description: Task 1 (Watchlist page) + Task 2 (Mini Chart sparklines) + Task 3 (Historical Analysis Comparison). Create watchlist.html, add /watchlist route, add /api/sparkline/<ticker> endpoint, add sparkline SVG rendering to hot-tickers and watchlist cards, add historical comparison panel to stocks.html.
steps: 1. Create dashboard/templates/watchlist.html extending base.html. Page shows user's watchlist (stored in localStorage). Each item shows: ticker, company name, current price, change%, last analysis score. Include add/remove functionality and a 'batch analyze all' button.
2. In dashboard/app.py add GET /watchlist HTML route that renders watchlist.html with title '自选股'.
3. In dashboard/templates/base.html add a Watchlist nav item in the sidebar under the '分析' group, after scanner, with an appropriate SVG icon and data-i18n='nav-watchlist' text '自选股'.

4. In dashboard/app.py add GET /api/sparkline/{ticker} endpoint. It uses augur.data.fetch_history(ticker, period='7d') to get last 7 trading days of close prices, returns JSON {ticker, prices: [float], trend: 'up'|'down'|'flat'}.

5. In index.html hot-tickers rendering (renderHotTickers function), after rendering each card, fetch /api/sparkline/<symbol> and render an inline SVG polyline (width ~80px, height ~30px). Green stroke for up trend, red for down.
6. In watchlist.html, also render sparkline SVGs for each watchlist item using the same approach.

7. In dashboard/templates/stocks.html add a '历史对比' (Historical Comparison) panel after the results section. It reads all cached analyses for the current ticker from localStorage (augurCache), displays them in a table with columns: Date, Score, Signal, Price. This lets users see how Augur's prediction changed over time.
8. Commit with message: 'feat: 自选股页面+迷你走势图+历史对比 (v7.6.0 任务1-3)'
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/sparkline/AAPL returns JSON with prices array
Sidebar in base.html contains Watchlist nav link
stocks.html contains historical comparison panel markup
findings: All 448 tests pass. Watchlist page created at /watchlist, sparkline API at /api/sparkline/{ticker}, nav item added to sidebar, historical comparison panel added to stocks.html, sparklines integrated into hot-tickers on index.html.
